title: TypeArrayMembers
description: Synthetic schema for members whose type is an array of JSON types. Each such member compiles to a generated enum with one variant per listed type; the keywords of each type (properties, bounds, items, enum values) apply to its variant.

required_count.description: Required nullable bounded integer: null is a value, absence is an error

optional_count.description: Optional nullable bounded integer: absent, null, or a value

level.description: Enum that contains null: a string enum plus a null variant

source_maps.description: Enum with strings and booleans: each type keeps its own enum values

libs.description: Nullable array whose items are a string enum

single.description: A one-element type array is the same as the plain type

tags.description: Array items with a type array

scores.description: A second array in the same object whose items have a different type array

env.description: Map values with a type array

paths.description: An array without an item schema, or a string: each JSON type goes to the variant of that type

rule_or_flag.description: A reference to an object-shaped definition without a type, next to a type array: the referenced struct for objects, a plain variant for booleans

rule_or_null.description: The same with null: an optional member that keeps absent, null, and present apart
